description.value: Discovery Coffee is a locally owned specialty coffee roaster based in Victoria, BC, with multiple cafe locations around the city. They roast all their beans in-house and are known for their craft approach to coffee. The Blanshard Street location sits in downtown Victoria, convenient for cyclists passing through the city centre.
